intervalSeconds.label: Check interval (seconds)
intervalSeconds.description: How often each host is checked. A host can set its own interval in its status settings. From 5 to 3600.

alertOnOffline.label: Alert when a host goes offline
alertOnOffline.description: Send the host's owner an alert when a checked host stops answering and when it is back.

view.title: Check host status
view.description: Check whether hosts you can see are online.
